segments: Every elemental bow starts here. Feed all three dragons, then claim the Wrath of the Ancients from the Family Crypt.
Three dragon heads around the castle
The old guide was wrong: you do NOT collect arrows from the dragon throats and you do NOT place three arrows into the Pyramid.
Kill eight zombies one at a time beneath the dragon above the tunnel near Double Tap. Wait for each eating animation before making the next kill.
Repeat the eight single-feed kills at the dragon in the fireplace / Mission Control area by Speed Cola.
Repeat the process at the dragon in the Pyramid / Undercroft. The head crumbles when it is completely fed.
After all three dragons crumble, go to the Family Crypt / Knight’s Tomb room above the Undercroft and take the Wrath of the Ancients from the altar.
A dragon only accepts one corpse at a time.
Start feeding dragons while opening the map so the base bow is ready early.
